sloka: जीवित अन्तकरम् घोरम् सादृश्यात् तु विशंकितः ।मूलघातो न नौ स्याद्धि द्वयोः इति कृतो मया ॥४-१२-३३॥
transliteration: jīvita antakaram ghoram sādṛśyāt tu viśaṁkitaḥ ।mūlaghāto na nau syāddhi dvayoḥ iti kṛto mayā ॥4-12-33॥

translations.english: 'I was doubtful because of your similar appearance. I thought that I should not strike at the very root of the interests of both of us. Therefore, I did not release the terrific and deadly arrow.
